# Advanced Telegram Economy

> Advanced Telegram Economy is a self-hosted Telegram economy bot for Node.js, built with Telegraf, TypeORM and SQLite. It adds salaries, a central bank, a market, cases, slots, money transfers and rankings to Telegram chats, in English or Turkish.

Run it from a clone with `npm install`, then `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=... LANG=en npm run start`. Set `LANG=tr` for Turkish; any other value gives English. Data is stored in `data.sqlite` in the working directory.

## Docs

- [Home](https://halitsever.github.io/advanced-telegram-economy/): overview of the bot's main features
- [Installation](https://halitsever.github.io/advanced-telegram-economy/installation.html): cloning the repository, installing dependencies and running the bot in dev or production mode

- [Source](https://github.com/halitsever/advanced-telegram-economy): repository

- [Command names](https://github.com/halitsever/advanced-telegram-economy/blob/main/src/lang/commands.en.js): English command names; Turkish ones are in commands.tr.js
